parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS recent_count FROM hestia_action_audit WHERE received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute';

{{
`INSERT INTO hestia_action_audit (
  request_id, requested_at, received_at, requested_by, action, risk, parameters,
  status, executed, requires_confirmation, result_summary
) VALUES (
  '${$json.sql_request_id}'::uuid,
  '${$json.sql_requested_at}'::timestamptz,
  '${String($json.received_at).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::timestamptz,
  '${$json.sql_requested_by}',
  '${$json.sql_action}',
  '${$json.sql_risk}',
  '{}'::jsonb,
  'received',
  false,
  false,
  '{}'::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, request_id, true AS inserted;`
}}

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS recent_security FROM hestia_events WHERE source = 'hestia_action_router' AND component = 'security' AND event = 'replay_detected' AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';
